test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boys, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Exactly two boys sit between S and N, to the right of S. P is an immediate neighbour of M and S. R is second to the right of P and to the immediate right of S. N is an immediate neighbour of Q and O. If O is third to the left of M, where is Q seated?

options.text: Fourth to the left of P
Second to the left of P
To the immediate left of P
Third to the left of P

solution: Given: 1) Exactly two boys sit between S and N, to the right of S. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f4496ba4b92a8df59708563412477971766fded03160ed6cea222aca1e0b09.png] 2) P is an immediate Neighbour of M and S.
